computation: Synthetic fixture only; actual HTTP, files, subprocesses and process-group signals
assertions: CLI rejects incomplete, empty, mismatched-branch, wrong-tip and malformed-revision completion receipts without claiming durable success.
Operation identity is printed before mutation; no automatic mutation retry; output and metadata remain separate.
Actual synthetic COW HTTP fixture exercises context, ask, prepared answer, continue, append, fork, rewind, history, auth and stale revisions.
Health/profile/readiness startup failures stop the owned service; launch failures close log handles; cleanup errors preserve the original cause.
Graceful SIGINT reaches only the HTTP leader; its worker is closed by the parent. Forced cleanup removes owned descendants without signalling a separate-session control process.
qualification: No original real-backend gate promotion. Real CLI campaigns are recorded separately.
